      Auto-reduce quantity after each spin (400 → 399)Reduces the winning item's count by 1 each time it is won, and removes it when it hits 0.
      Spread duplicates around the wheelInterleaves items proportionally so identical prizes don't form one big block. Odds are unchanged.

        Step 1 of 2
        The wheel has spoken
        —

        Spin The Wheel

        A quick tour — about thirty seconds. You can bring this back any time with ? in the top bar.

        1
        Put things on the wheel

        In the Segments tab, type a name, set its quantity (even 400+), and press Add.

        2
        Crash-Proof Auto-Recovery

        Every spin saves your remaining counts immediately to browser storage, IndexedDB, and the URL hash so a refresh or crash resumes right where you left off.

        3
        Themes, Fonts & Logos

        Open the Themes tab in the setup sidebar to override slice font size/colour, scale header/hub logos, and customise glow and confetti.

        4
        One-Button Present Mode

        Click ⛶ Present (or press P) to enter fullscreen and tuck all controls behind a single top-left ☰ button.

        Running it live? Lock your starting baseline in the Segments tab before your event begins, or use Start Fresh on load for a clean Prize 1–5 setup.
